representation_fit.evidence: Primary object is a draggable canvas_object on a shared spatial canvas (source/core.js:98-108); state is determined purely by physical placement — zone membership recomputed from object center coordinates (core.js:48-56), exactly matching the brief's '落位即意图' (brief.md:10,27). Three physical zones 待选池/就位区/定稿区 with grid snap (core.js:8-12, core.js:46) are visible in both screenshots as a physical workspace.

primary_task_salience.evidence: The canvas fills ~93% of both viewports with 9 seeded objects already placed in zones (screenshots 1280x860 and 1440x900); create/duplicate/delete are the first toolbar controls (source/index.html:18-20); initial data is rendered synchronously at script load with no loading state (source/input.js:8-13 seedObjects()+fitAll() before event binding).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: the initial screen is self-explanatory within seconds — tagline states the rule '放进哪个区，就是什么状态' (index.html:15, visible top-left in both screenshots), each zone shows name + live count + hint ('先扔进来再说'/'排期与依赖已确认'/'落位即承诺', core.js:9-11, visible in both screenshots), and the status bar lists interaction hints (index.html:52).

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero navigation: single screen (brief constraint '主屏 1 个', brief.md:44); the primary object is visible on load; every operation is 0-1 steps via toolbar (index.html:18-32), direct manipulation, or direct shortcuts (Ctrl+1/2/3 moves object to a zone, input.js:168; N creates, input.js:195-197).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-place: drag-to-rezone with live zone highlight (input.js:88-90), inline contenteditable title editing (core.js:238-263), undo/redo snapshots (core.js:60-78), live status bar with pointer-zone readout (input.js:65-69); the only overlay is an opt-in help panel closable with Esc (index.html:55-80, input.js:142-143). No page transitions or modal flows in the primary path.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are just topbar + statusbar + canvas; all 13 toolbar buttons map to documented keyboard equivalents (index.html:18-32; help table index.html:61-77), so density is functional rather than redundant. Minor cost: .tools uses flex-wrap (styles.css:33) and the 快捷键 button wraps to a second toolbar row at 1280x860 (visible in 1280x860 screenshot).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast pass and a11y.target_size pass, but a11y.focus_order skipped (measurement-summary.json:13-15) — focus order unverified. Keyboard coverage is exceptional (every spatial op has an equivalent, input.js:139-207; help table index.html:61-77), but it replaces native traversal: Tab is preventDefault-ed for object cycling (input.js:184-193) and all buttons are force-blurred after click (input.js:227), so real DOM focus is deliberately discarded. Canvas objects are plain divs with no role/aria-label (core.js:98-108). type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json:16) compounds this: at fitted zoom 78%/88% (both screenshots' status bars) 11-11.5px text (styles.css:76,79,105) projects well below readable size.

frontend_rework.evidence: Two of seven receipt checks failed: layout.overflow fail (measurement-summary.json:11) and type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json:16). Visible defect: toolbar wraps to two rows at 1280x860 (快捷键 button on second row, 1280x860 screenshot; styles.css:33) while fitting on one row at 1440x900 — a responsive-fit defect implying rework. No text truncation observed (text.truncation pass, measurement-summary.json:13).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '空间操作有键盘等价物' (brief.md:36) is the app's stated thesis — tagline (index.html:15) and help panel literally titled '空间操作 ⇄ 键盘等价物' (index.html:58) with a 12-row mapping table (index.html:61-77). Implemented in code: arrows nudge / pan when nothing selected (input.js:177-183), Ctrl+1/2/3 zone placement (input.js:168), Tab cycle selection (input.js:184-193), N create (input.js:195-197), S snap (input.js:198-199), [/] z-order (input.js:200-201), +/-/0/1 zoom (input.js:202-205), Ctrl+Z/Y/D/Delete (input.js:164-172).

task_completion_time, information_retrieval_accuracy, human_preference: no user study in this pilot (rubric.md:25-31)
scores.overall_note: impl-13 is a strong, on-brief realization of the create × spatial-workspace cell: a single-screen dark canvas where physical placement in three color-coded zones (待选池/就位区/定稿区) literally is state, with zone membership recomputed from object geometry (core.js:48-56) and initial data ready on first paint with no loading state (input.js:8-13). The acceptance seed — keyboard equivalents for every spatial operation — is not just covered but made the product's stated thesis, implemented across create/select/move/rezone/zoom/reorder/undo (input.js:139-207, index.html:61-77). Primary-object salience, navigation cost, and context preservation are all effectively optimal since there is no navigation at all. The measurable weaknesses sit at the edges: two of seven receipt checks fail (layout.overflow, type.min_projected_size), the toolbar visibly wraps at 1280x860, and the deliberate bypassing of native focus (Tab hijack, post-click blur, role-less canvas divs) leaves accessibility resting entirely on custom keyboard handling while the one check that would verify it was skipped. Model-judged comprehension proxy is high, but this is not human preference data.
